source_spec.v1_status: REJECTED; do not modify or relabel its result

reason.interpretation: Both weak cost-adjusted selection and insufficient opportunity density; simply increasing exposure or leverage is not justified. Rejection reasons overlap and are not causal ablation estimates.

trial_budget.changes_after_results: new experiment version; keep failed results
trial_budget.control_seeds: 0 through 199; historical eligible pool, identical execution/cost/risk policy; no future membership

common.universe: Historical top80 USDT spot by trailing30 mean quote volume, minimum1m USDT; 240 consecutive days; ended markets retained
common.market_gate: BTC prior completed daily close above SMA200; weekly/monthly context uses only completed bars
common.execution: D signal close, D+1 observation, earliest D+2 open; inherited gap rejection and stop-first execution
common.initial_stop: signal close minus2.5 ATR14; reject if distance outside3%..18%; size again at actual simulated execution
common.missing_held: full-loss writeoff when unobservable at close; no hindsight last-price liquidation
common.instrument: unborrowed spot; funding0; no leverage test until edge gates pass
common.classification: price proxies, not fundamental revaluation evidence

challenger_A.name: relative_strength_recovery
challenger_A.hypothesis: A recovery of relative strength after a sustained below-trend period identifies early repricing more efficiently than a narrow absolute56day range.
entry_all: At least14 of the28 days immediately preceding the last7 completed days closed below their own causal SMA50
At least one close in last7 completed days crossed from below to above causal SMA50; latest close remains above SMA50
Latest close is10%..60% below trailing180day high
28day asset return minus BTC28day return is at least0.03
Asset7day return <=0.12 and28day return between0 and0.30
Mean true range of last10 days / mean true range of preceding30 days <=0.90
Latest completed weekly close is above preceding weekly close
challenger_A.rank: descending28day relative return; symbol ascending for ties
challenger_A.exit: BTC market gate fails, or close below SMA50 after7days held, or84days held; weekly delayed plan
challenger_A.partial_profit: half at3 initial R; inherited stop-first convention
challenger_A.trailing_stop: weekly max(existing stop,20day low minus0.25 ATR14)

challenger_B.name: established_trend_controlled_pullback
challenger_B.hypothesis: Buying a bounded pullback in a sustained trend produces more repeated opportunities without unconditional breakout chasing.
challenger_B.observation_frequency: daily; regime inputs still completed weekly/monthly context
entry_all: SMA50 > SMA200 and latest SMA50 > its value20completed days earlier
Latest close is8%..25% below trailing60day high
Latest close exceeds previous close and latest daily open
Asset7day return <=0.08 and28day return between-0.15 and0.25
90day asset return minus BTC90day return is positive
challenger_B.rank: descending90day relative return; symbol ascending for ties
challenger_B.exit: BTC market gate fails, or close below SMA50, or21days held; daily delayed plan
challenger_B.partial_profit: half at3 initial R; inherited stop-first convention
challenger_B.trailing_stop: daily delayed max(existing stop,10day low minus0.25 ATR14)

chronology.selection_rule: Freeze both complete specs and code hashes before running. Evaluate both, retain both failures. Select at most one only if all gates pass; otherwise select none. No splicing winners across years.
chronology.warning: These periods were already inspected for v1; historical validation is not untouched OOS. A genuinely new forward paper interval of at least90days starts only after code freeze, without orders.

edge_gates_before_forward_paper.interpretation: Two challengers:97.5th percentile control hurdle is a conservative multiplicity-aware screen, not a proof of future profitability. Monthly blocks handle only part of dependence.

capital_growth_relevance_gates.interpretation: Economic research hurdle only:1% monthly on20m is200k, still far below5m. Even passing requires a capital-growth phase; it does not authorize withdrawals or leverage.

discarded: Multiplying v1 exposure or applying2x/3x leverage while stress expectancy is negative
Removing several v1 filters and selecting whichever historical variant looks best
Claiming a low-priced or compressed chart proves fundamental undervaluation
Treating historical monthly median0 as a dependable cashflow stream

fundamental_followup_if_both_fail.scope: A separate point-in-time catalyst dataset, not backfilled present-day fundamentals

conventions.accounts: Each strategy and cost: continuous, eight independent calendar-year accounts (2026 ends September), three independent era accounts. Never splice reset accounts. Continuous attribution also reported by era and year.

implementation_conventions.returns: r_N = close[D]/close[D-N]-1; relative strength is arithmetic return difference, not ratio
implementation_conventions.high: Maximum daily HIGH including D in the stated trailing window
implementation_conventions.sma: Arithmetic mean of completed daily CLOSE including each SMA date
implementation_conventions.atr: Arithmetic mean of last14 true ranges, not Wilder smoothing; initial stop = signal close -2.5 ATR
implementation_conventions.below_history: 28 observations D-34 through D-7, excluding latest seven D-6 through D; each below its own causal SMA50
implementation_conventions.cross: Previous close strictly below previous SMA50 and current close strictly above current SMA50, on at least one of D-6 through D
implementation_conventions.tr_contraction: Mean TR D-9..D divided by mean TR D-39..D-10; zero denominator fails
implementation_conventions.holding_age: At signal observation (D+1 00:00 UTC) minus actual entry open; inherited convention
implementation_conventions.context: BTC gate uses D completed close; A week is completed Sunday. No extra inherited v1 weekly/monthly-return entry filter is added to either challenger.
implementation_conventions.no_adds: New entries allow the broker BUY path; all held targets have allow_add=false. Inherited risk/weight trims, stops, partial exits and stale-plan protection retained.
implementation_conventions.delays: D close observed D+1; entries, planned exits and tightened stops become eligible D+2 open. Existing stops and 3R partial profit operate every daily bar, stop first.
implementation_conventions.capacity: Held valid positions first, then fixed-ranked new candidates; no replacement with tomorrow's information
implementation_conventions.idle_cash: Zero interest, no borrowing or leverage; cash included in all returns and exposure denominators
implementation_conventions.missing_market: First missing held daily candle: zero recovery at close, no hindsight terminal-price exit. Shortened and zero-volume source candles retained and audited.
implementation_conventions.history: 240 consecutive daily observations with known LUNA identity boundary reset. Historical archive availability, not present exchangeInfo, defines membership. Full official listing and migration history remains uncertified.
implementation_conventions.krw: Scale USDT net returns to 20m KRW at constant FX, before tax. Show fixed-20m month return PnL, original-account compounding PnL and realized PnL separately; no withdrawals assumed. This is not measured FX-adjusted cash income.

controls.sampling: At each original strategy signal date, K is the count of price-rule qualifiers in the whole historical top80 before holdings/capacity. Draw min(K,N) without replacement from that day's same top80 with BTC gate and 3%..18% initial-stop feasibility. Existing holdings may be drawn; no replacement, no adds. Rank drawn symbols with fresh deterministic random numbers. Same strategy-specific exit, trailing, delay, cost, halt and risk policies.
controls.rng: Python random.Random(f'{strategy}:{seed}:{signal_day_ms}'); sorted eligible symbols; sample then random ranking
controls.statistic: Arithmetic mean of full-calendar-month net returns of the continuous stress account, including idle months
controls.percentile: Number of 200 controls strictly below challenger statistic divided by 200; ties count against challenger; require >=0.975
controls.diagnostic_p: (1 + controls with statistic >= challenger)/(201), reported as Monte Carlo comparison only
controls.retain: Keep seed, performance, monthly path, independent ledger checks and artifact digest; individual ledgers outside Git. Do all controls even when other gates already fail.

uncertainty.method: 4000 circular moving-block resamples of full-month net returns, block length3 months, seed20261025; percentile 2.5% and97.5% endpoints
uncertainty.gate: Lower endpoint of historical 95% interval for arithmetic mean monthly net return must exceed0

decision.gates: Apply every edge_gates_before_forward_paper and capital_growth_relevance_gates value in the unchanged source spec to stress results
decision.positive_calendar_fold_fraction: Positive net-return independent calendar accounts divided by8, including partial2026; threshold0.60 requires at least5/8
decision.challenge_count: Closed campaigns in the independent 2025-01-01..2026-10-01 challenge account
decision.mdd: Continuous stress daily-close MDD plus independent-fold MDD reported. Gate checks continuous AND each reset account, with no permanent halt in any account. Intraday simultaneous-low bound separately reported; trigger is not a guaranteed cap.
decision.PASS: All gates pass and all required audits/controls completed; only eligible for a separate at-least90-day new forward-paper interval
decision.REJECT: Any measured profitability, stability, capital-growth or drawdown/halt gate fails; preserve failed parameters
decision.NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: No measured failure but samples insufficient, or mandatory audit/data/control evidence incomplete; never PASS an unverified run
decision.selection: At most one. If both PASS, higher stress mean full-month net return; ties choose lower MDD magnitude then strategy name. Otherwise select none or the sole PASS.

conventions.future_prefix_test: Physically delete every bar on/after2023-01-01; compare all earlier equity, fills, writeoffs and plans for all four continuous accounts, with no terminal liquidation on truncated run
conventions.independent_reproduction: Separate validator process reconstructs daily cash/inventory/campaigns, source market eligibility and candidate rules, then reruns all four continuous accounts from new panel objects. Same-author code validation is not an external investment audit.
